    姜无痕翻看了半天，有些眼花缭乱。

    下界天骄数量虽多，但良莠不齐。

    他看了两百多个，评分能达到90以上的，连十分之一都不到。

    即便是那些勉强能达到评分要求的，看上去也没什么特别出彩的地方，相比于林清雅、沐云溪，差了不止一星半点。

    “小无痕，看了这么多，感觉怎么样？”姜临战凑过来，笑着问道，“方才老夫注意到了几个不错的，都是好生养的类型。如果娶回来，绝对能帮咱们姜家开枝散叶！”

    姜临天端来一杯悟道茶，抬手打在姜无痕的肩膀上，劝慰道：“无痕，别听大长老瞎说，他上了年纪，眼光不行。”

    “三千中千世界，无数小千世界，虽也诞生出了无数天骄，但相较于阎浮大世界，终究还是差了些。你既然与老祖们定下了‘阳谋’，确定要从下界寻道侣加以培养，一鸣惊人，就无需太过吹毛求疵，选个差不多的就行了！”

    “待到计划成功，各大势力主动将他们的天之骄女送上门来的时候，想要什么样的道侣没有？”

    在他看来，下界修士终究是下界修士，即便矬子里面拔将军，也根本无法与上界天骄相提并论。

    来自下界的道侣，也仅仅只是一枚棋子而已！

    “不急，我再找找……”

    姜无痕继续翻看着，忽然，他的目光定格在一副画像投影上。

    【安祈雪】

    【评分：94】

    【身份：创生莲华界，三生阁圣主】

    【体质：并蒂仙灵体（神体）】

    【数据：175cm，110/72/112】

    【雷：E+】

    【对接次数：0】

    【弱点：尚未攻略，无法查看！】

    一瞬间，姜无痕心头一惊！

    这分数，这数值！

    下界居然也能诞生出如此天骄！

    同时，他看到了安祈雪的其他详细信息。

    作为三生阁的圣主，掌控‘轮回法则’，乃是创生莲华界十大‘至尊’强者之一！

    Jiang Wuhen looked through it for a long time, feeling a little dazzled.

    Although the number of geniuses in the lower realm is large, the good and the bad are mixed.

    He has read more than two hundred movies, and the ratings can reach over 90, not even one tenth.

    Even those who can barely meet the rating requirements don't seem to be particularly outstanding. Compared with Lin Qingya and Mu Yunxi, they are more than one and a half stars behind.

    "Xiao Wuhen, how do you feel after seeing so much?" Jiang Linzhan came over and asked with a smile, "I just noticed a few good ones, all of whom are easy to have children. If you marry them back, they will definitely help our Jiang family flourish!"

    Jiang Lintian brought a cup of enlightenment tea, raised his hand and hit Jiang Wuhen on the shoulder, comforting him: "Wuhen, don't listen to the elder's nonsense. He is old and has poor vision."

    "Three Thousands of Thousand Worlds and Countless Small Thousand Worlds have given birth to countless geniuses, but compared to the big world of Jamfu, they are still inferior after all. Since you have made a 'conspiracy' with the ancestors and are determined to find Taoist companions from the lower world to train them and make them a hit, there is no need to be too picky, just choose someone who is similar!"

    "When the plan is successful and the major forces take the initiative to send their proud daughters to your doorstep, what kind of Taoist companion do you want?"

    In his opinion, monks from the lower world are still monks from the lower world. Even if they become generals, they cannot compare with the geniuses from the upper world.

    The Taoist companion from the lower realm is just a chess piece!

    "Don't worry, I'll look for it again..."

    Jiang Wuhen continued to look through it, and suddenly, his eyes were fixed on a projection of a portrait.

    【An Qixue】

    [Rating: 94]

    [Identity: Creation Lotus Realm, Holy Lord of Sansheng Pavilion]

    [Physique: Bingdixian spiritual body (divine body)]

    [Data: 175cm, 110/72/112]

    [Thunder: E+]

    [Number of dockings: 0]

    [Weakness: It has not been conquered yet and cannot be viewed! 】

    For a moment, Jiang Wuhen was shocked!

    This score, this value!

    The lower world can actually give birth to such a genius!

    At the same time, he saw other details about An Qixue.

    As the Holy Lord of Sansheng Pavilion, he controls the 'Law of Reincarnation' and is one of the ten 'Supreme' powerful men in the Creation Lotus Realm!
